enums.name: ke_result_domain
enums.doc: The domains that own a range of result codes. A domain's own codes are written `KE_RESULT_CODE(KE_RESULT_DOMAIN_ <DOMAIN >, n)` in its header, with `n` from 1 up.

enums.name: ke_result
enums.doc: What a fallible call returns: `KE_OK`, or the code of the failure. The detail of a failure goes to the failing library's log, never into the code. A caller treats a code it does not know as `KE_RESULT_GENERAL`. Ignoring the result of a call is a compiler warning where the compiler supports it.

enums.name: ke_assembly_failure
enums.doc: Why a composition cannot be assembled.

values.name: KE_ASSEMBLY_FAILURE_UNKNOWN_PART
values.doc: An instance names a part no one added.

values.name: KE_ASSEMBLY_FAILURE_UNKNOWN_NAME
values.doc: A binding, an order or a default names an instance or a slot that does not exist.

values.name: KE_ASSEMBLY_FAILURE_UNSATISFIED
values.doc: A slot that takes one instance has no candidate.

values.name: KE_ASSEMBLY_FAILURE_AMBIGUOUS
values.doc: A slot that takes one instance has more than one candidate and the composition chose none.

values.name: KE_ASSEMBLY_FAILURE_WRONG_CONTRACT
values.doc: A bound instance does not provide the slot's contract.

values.name: KE_ASSEMBLY_FAILURE_CYCLE
values.doc: The instances need each other, or the orders of a slot contradict each other.

values.name: KE_ASSEMBLY_FAILURE_DUPLICATE
values.doc: A part, an instance or an external contract is given a name already taken.

values.name: KE_ASSEMBLY_FAILURE_SHARED_SECTION
values.doc: Instances of different parts are created with the same section, whose keys one of them would refuse.

vtables.name: ke_completion
vtables.doc: Work that finishes once, with a result: a job, an asynchronous operation, a read, a run, a submission. Whoever received it releases it exactly once; a completion that another call borrowed as a dependency is released only after the work that depends on it completed.

slots.name: poll
slots.doc: Whether the work finished; callable from any thread.

params.name: out_result
params.doc: Receives what the work finished with, when it finished.

slots.name: wait
slots.doc: Blocks until the work finishes and returns what it finished with. Callable from the thread that created the system the completion came from, and from inside a job when the completion came from that job system.
slots.return_doc: What the work finished with; KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED, at once, from any other thread, where the completion is passed as a dependency instead.

slots.name: release
slots.doc: Gives the completion back; the pointer is invalid afterwards. The work itself is not stopped.

vtables.name: ke_settings
vtables.doc: The values one part is created with, each under a key and of one type, and the settings nested under it, each under a name. A list of values is a key per element, named by its index after a dot ("tint.0"); a list of tables is a child per element, named by its index ("0"). A part reads them once, when it is created; a value that changes afterwards is a slot of the part's own contract.

slots.name: get_bool
slots.doc: Reads a boolean.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_NOT_FOUND when no value is under key; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null argument or when the value under key is of another type.

params.name: key
params.doc: The key.

params.name: out_value
params.doc: Receives the value; untouched on failure.

slots.name: get_int
slots.doc: Reads an integer, as get_bool.

params.name: key
params.doc: The key.

params.name: out_value
params.doc: Receives the value; untouched on failure.

slots.name: get_double
slots.doc: Reads a floating-point number, as get_bool. An integer value is read as its number.

params.name: key
params.doc: The key.

params.name: out_value
params.doc: Receives the value; untouched on failure.

slots.name: get_string
slots.doc: Reads a string, as get_bool.

params.name: key
params.doc: The key.

params.name: out_value
params.doc: Receives the string, borrowed while the settings live and the key is not written again.

slots.name: for_each_key
slots.doc: Calls each once for every key that holds a value, in no particular order.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, or KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null each.

params.name: each
params.doc: Called once per key.

slots.name: child
slots.doc: Gives the settings nested under name, empty when nothing is.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null argument; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

params.name: name
params.doc: The child's name.

params.name: out_settings
params.doc: Receives the child, lent while these settings live.

slots.name: for_each_child
slots.doc: Calls each once for every child that holds a key or a child of its own, in the order it was first written.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null each; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

params.name: each
params.doc: Called once per child, with its name.

vtables.name: ke_assembly
vtables.doc: Assembles instances of parts from a composition: which instances exist, of which part, with which section of settings, and which instance each slot is bound to. Nothing is created before the whole composition resolves. Every name is copied. Gathering records what it is given and checks nothing: every mistake in it, as a name taken twice or one nothing declares, is reported by resolve, with the others.

slots.name: route_log
slots.doc: Sends every line the parts' libraries log to log: resolve calls each distinct log setter of the parts once, before anything is created. Without it they log to stderr.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null log; KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED after resolve.

params.name: log
params.doc: Receives each line, on whichever thread logged; must outlive the assembly.

params.name: log_ctx
params.doc: Handed to log unchanged.

slots.name: add_part
slots.doc: Makes part available to instances.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null part; KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED after resolve; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

params.name: part
params.doc: Must outlive the assembly.

slots.name: add_instance
slots.doc: Declares the instance name of the part part, created with the section section of the configuration.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null name or part; KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED after resolve; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

params.name: name
params.doc: Unique among the instances.

params.name: part
params.doc: A part's name.

params.name: section
params.doc: A section of the configuration; NULL creates the instance with empty settings.

slots.name: add_external
slots.doc: Declares that the instance name, made by someone else, provides contract as instance; called once per contract it provides. Never destroyed by the assembly.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null argument; KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED after resolve; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

params.name: name
params.doc: No instance of a part has it.

params.name: contract
params.doc: The contract instance is the vtable of.

params.name: instance
params.doc: Must outlive the assembly.

slots.name: bind
slots.doc: Binds the slot slot of instance to target; a slot that takes many is bound once per target.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null argument; KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED after resolve; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

params.name: target
params.doc: An instance's name.

slots.name: order
slots.doc: Orders two instances bound to the slot slot of instance: first comes before then. Instances of a slot with no order between them come in no guaranteed order. With no slot, orders two instances bound to slots of instance, the same or different ones, by the positions the part receives.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null argument other than slot; KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED after resolve; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

params.name: slot
params.doc: NULL orders across the slots of instance.

slots.name: set_default
slots.doc: Names the instance every slot of contract the composition binds nothing to takes.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null argument; KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED after resolve; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

slots.name: resolve
slots.doc: Resolves the whole composition, creating nothing. A slot that takes one instance, or none, takes the one bound to it, else the default of its contract, else the only instance that provides it; a slot that takes many takes exactly the instances bound to it, none when nothing is. Every reason it cannot be assembled is reported.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_ASSEMBLY_UNRESOLVED when any reason was found; KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED when already resolved.

params.name: report
params.doc: Receives each reason; NULL reports none.

params.name: ctx
params.doc: Handed to report unchanged.

slots.name: advance
slots.doc: Creates the instances whose slots are ready, each after every instance it is bound to became usable, pumping the instances already made while one is not.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK once every instance is made and usable; KE_RESULT_PENDING while one is becoming usable; KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED before resolve; the code an instance failed to be created or to become usable with, every instance made so far destroyed in reverse.

slots.name: get
slots.doc: Gives the instance name as the vtable of contract.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_NOT_FOUND when no instance has that name, it does not provide contract or it is not made yet; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null argument.

params.name: contract
params.doc: One of the contracts the instance provides.

params.name: out_instance
params.doc: Receives the vtable.

vtables.name: ke_assembly_handle
vtables.doc: Destroying it destroys every instance it made, in the reverse of the order it made them.

vtables.name: ke_composition_source
vtables.doc: Reads a composition from somewhere outside the process into an assembly, through its composition slots (add_instance, bind, order, set_default); it adds no part, since which parts exist is what the host linked. A source keeps nothing between loads.

slots.name: load
slots.doc: Writes the composition path holds into assembly. Calls made before a failure stay; resolve reports any mistake in what was written.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null argument; KE_RESULT_NOT_FOUND when path holds nothing; KE_RESULT_GENERAL when the content does not parse or holds a key the source does not know; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY; or the code of the call to assembly that failed.

params.name: assembly
params.doc: The assembly written to.

params.name: path
params.doc: Where the composition is read from.

callbacks.name: ke_log_callback
callbacks.doc: Receives one line a plugin library logged. Each plugin library exports ` <library >_set_log_callback(ke_log_callback callback, void *ctx)`, declared in its ` <library >_log.h`; the host sets it once, before the library logs, and a NULL callback sends the library's lines to stderr, which is also where they go until it is set. Called on whichever thread logged.

lanes.name: ctx
lanes.doc: The pointer given to the setter, unchanged.

lanes.name: level
lanes.doc: How severe the line is: error, warning, info or debug.

lanes.name: scope
lanes.doc: The name of what logged: the plugin, or a third-party library it routes. Valid only during the call.

lanes.name: message
lanes.doc: The formatted line. Valid only during the call.

callbacks.name: ke_settings_key_func
callbacks.doc: Receives one key the settings hold.

lanes.name: key
lanes.doc: The key; valid only during the call.

callbacks.name: ke_assembly_report_fn
callbacks.doc: Receives one reason a composition cannot be assembled.

lanes.name: instance
lanes.doc: The instance it concerns; valid only during the call.

lanes.name: name
lanes.doc: The slot, part or instance name it concerns; valid only during the call.

lanes.name: detail
lanes.doc: A line naming what was found: for a name nothing declares, the names of that kind that exist; for a slot with no candidate, the instances that provide its contract; for an ambiguous one, the candidates. Valid only during the call.

type_aliases.ke_log_callback: void (*)(void *, ke_log_level, const char *, const char *)
type_aliases.ke_assembly_report_fn: void (*)(void *, ke_assembly_failure, const char *, const char *, const char *)

constants.name: KE_RESULT_ASSEMBLY_UNRESOLVED
constants.doc: What resolve returns when the composition cannot be assembled.
